items.title: Hal Espinosa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 20, 2024
items.q: I got to know the Neiderlanders — Jimmy Neiderlander, who owned you know half of Broadway at the time. I got to meet him.

ctx.x: The virtual orchestra. Thank you. That’s the problem I had when I was president of the local. We had in our contracts with the theaters there a minimum of at least 18 musicians. New York — their minimums usually were like 24 for their largest theaters. And our theaters that we have in L.A. they were all larger than the largest one other than where the Rockettes perform. You know that’s a big one. But at that time they were all maybe 1000 seats, 800 seats, 1200 maybe. Ours were like 1800 seats and similar to that,…
